{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter to treatment arm
df_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response rate by sex and severity
response_by_sex_severity = df_treatment.groupby(['sex', 'severity'])['responded'].mean() * 100

# Extract stratum-specific differences (F - M)
response_diff_by_severity = response_by_sex_severity.unstack(level='sex').diff(axis=1)['F']

# Compute weights: proportion of each severity level in treatment arm
weights = df_treatment['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Compute adjusted difference: weighted average of stratum-specific differences
adjusted_diff = (response_diff_by_severity * weights).sum()

# Print all required values for evidence
print(f'Adjusted difference (F - M) in response rate: {adjusted_diff:.6f} percentage points')
print(f'Stratum-specific differences (F - M):\n{response_diff_by_severity}')
print(f'Severity weights (proportions):\n{weights}')"}
